correctness.rationale: The affine tangent expansion exhausts all finite hyperflex candidates; the infinity chart excludes further hyperflexes by contact order three. Direct substitution proves order-four contact at all four claimed points. The cross-ratio identity is exact, and coefficient comparison proves the kernel is precisely y-scaling by fourth roots of unity. With the published automorphism-group order 48, the image has order 12 and equals the full equianharmonic stabilizer A4. The bundled verifier replays every algebraic identity using exact symbolic arithmetic.

value.rationale: The result gives a structural geometric meaning to the noncentral A4 quotient of the exceptional order-48 automorphism group: it is the tetrahedral symmetry of an intrinsic equianharmonic hyperflex divisor. It simultaneously explains the four-line concurrency and replaces auxiliary-parameter line equations by a canonical four-point configuration, which is useful for studying bitangent actions and moduli symmetry rather than being a routine coordinate restatement.
